min_standing_note.value: Must be nominated by a partner university and have completed at least one full year of university study prior to attending (no numeric minimum GPA published for incoming visiting exchange).

eligible_auc_schools.notes: Normalized from agreement_scope_raw == 'University-wide' (Northwestern school-level exclusions noted in excluded_majors).

eligible_majors.notes: Normalized from agreement_scope_raw == 'University-wide' (Northwestern school-level exclusions noted in excluded_majors).

excluded_majors.notes: Medill School of Journalism is Limited Access (not fully excluded), whereas IMC, Bienen, Kellogg, Pritzker Law, and Feinberg Medicine are excluded for visiting undergraduate exchange.

min_gpa_host.notes: Incoming visiting exchange eligibility (applying-to-study-at-northwestern.html) requires partner nomination, >=1 year completed study, and English proficiency; no numeric minimum GPA is published (3.0 GPA on GLO Study Abroad applies to outgoing NU students, not incoming exchange).

english_proficiency_and_rhet1020.value: Non-native English speakers must provide proof of English proficiency via TOEFL/IELTS scores or an official supporting letter from their home university confirming English proficiency (no fixed numeric exchange minimum or RHET 1020 exemption stated on GLO visiting-student page).

fall_term_dates.value: Fall Quarter 2026: Classes Sep 23 – Dec 5, 2026; Final Exams Dec 7 – Dec 12, 2026 (plus mandatory pre-term arrival/orientation).

spring_term_dates.value: Quarter system — Winter Quarter 2027: Classes Jan 4 – Mar 13, 2027, Final Exams Mar 15 – Mar 20, 2027; Spring Quarter 2027: Classes Mar 30 – Jun 5, 2027, Final Exams Jun 7 – Jun 11, 2027.

tuition_model.notes: GLO visiting exchange page specifies $0 Northwestern tuition; exchange students continue paying home university tuition.

est_monthly_living_local.notes: Derived monthly figure from GLO AY 2026-2027 per-quarter visiting exchange recurring living budget: Housing $4,200 + Meals $2,950 + Books & Supplies $300 + Transportation $200 + Personal Expenses $850 = $8,500/quarter / 3 months = $2,833/month (excludes $2,000/quarter NU-SHIP health insurance documented in mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance and $2,000 one-time pre-arrival travel/misc).

living_cost_usd_est.notes: USD official GLO per-quarter budget scaled to 5-month equivalent (1 USD = 1.0 USD, no FX conversion; 5 * $2,833/mo = $14,165 USD; calculated 2026-11-15). Note: Northwestern operates a 10-week quarter system (1 quarter recurring living budget is $8,500, or $10,500 incl. $2,000 NU-SHIP, or $12,500 incl. $2,000 one-time pre-arrival); a two-quarter stay scales proportionally.

mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.value: Mandatory Northwestern University Student Health Insurance Plan (NU-SHIP): estimated $2,000/quarter on GLO visiting student budget (annual 2026-2027 NU-SHIP rate is $5,996 for Sep 1, 2026 - Aug 31, 2027; automatically billed unless an approved comparable waiver is granted).
mandatory_host_fees_and_insurance.notes: Quarterly $2,000 NU-SHIP line item also listed at https://www.northwestern.edu/abroad/visiting-students/preparing-for-northwestern/costs-money-management.html.

housing_availability.notes: On-campus housing is not guaranteed, but Northwestern assists admitted visiting exchange students via an online housing contract placed based on availability.

housing_notes.value: On-campus housing is not guaranteed; admitted visiting students submit a binding online housing contract through Residential Services and are placed based on availability (billed directly by NU for room and board; GLO estimates $4,200/quarter housing + $2,950/quarter meals). Early check-in before hall opening is restricted.

visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.value: Non-U.S. visiting exchange students require a J-1 Student Visa (Form DS-2019) via OISS. After admission and OISS Portal access (https://oissportal.northwestern.edu), OISS processing takes up to 4 weeks once a complete DS-2019 request and financial packet are submitted. Financial proof: liquid funds (bank statement dated within 6 months, plus Sponsor Statement of Support if family/friend-funded) guaranteed for the full program length (GLO 1-quarter visiting student budget totals $12,500 incl. NU-SHIP and pre-arrival; plus additional funds if bringing J-2 dependents).
visa_lead_time_and_financial_proof.notes: Up to 4-week OISS DS-2019 processing timeline from https://www.northwestern.edu/international/students/steps-for-newly-admitted-students/index.html; visiting student J-1/DS-2019 requirement and $12,500/quarter budget from https://www.northwestern.edu/abroad/visiting-students/preparing-for-northwestern/costs-money-management.html.

english_course_list_url.notes: All undergraduate courses in the main Northwestern catalog (https://catalogs.northwestern.edu/undergraduate/) are taught in English; no separate English-taught course list exists.

credit_system_and_load.value: Quarter unit system (10-week Fall/Winter/Spring quarters; 1 course = 1 credit unit). Full-time visiting exchange load is 3 to 4 course units per quarter.

course_restrictions_note.value: Visiting exchange students have full access (prerequisites and open seats permitting) to undergraduate courses in Weinberg College of Arts & Sciences and McCormick School of Engineering & Applied Science; limited access to Medill (School of Journalism, Media, Integrated Marketing Communications), School of Education and Social Policy (SESP), School of Communication, and School of Professional Studies (SPS); Integrated Marketing Communications (IMC), Bienen School of Music, Kellogg School of Management, Pritzker School of Law, Feinberg School of Medicine, and 400-level+ graduate courses are closed/not open.

value: Proof of English proficiency (TOEFL/IELTS or home university supporting letter)

academic_style.value: Fast-paced 10-week quarter system at a private research university with full liberal arts & engineering integration (Weinberg & McCormick); course prerequisites and attendance policies vary by department.

city_tier.notes: Evanston campus borders Chicago 12 miles north of downtown, but exact city population threshold was not verified from northwestern.edu.

campus_type.notes: Northwestern describes its Evanston campus (12 miles north of downtown Chicago) as a 'Blend of Urban and Suburban' (https://admissions.northwestern.edu/student-life/evanston-and-chicago.html), which does not map cleanly to a single schema enum ('urban' vs 'suburban'); left unknown per strict provenance rules.

daily_life_english_friendliness.notes: US host institution operating fully in English.

international_support_services.value: Mandatory pre-term orientation & GLO advising, OISS immigration & J-1 compliance check-in, and International Wildcat Welcome / peer transition programming.

nomination_deadlines.value: Fall Quarter: Opens Mar 1, Deadline Apr 1; Winter Quarter: Opens Jun 1, Deadline Jul 1; Spring Quarter: Opens Sep 1, Deadline Oct 1 (must be nominated by home university first).
